questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Yo ___ español y un poco de francés.'
questions.explanation: For yo, drop -ar and add -o: habl- + -o = hablo. The -o ending can only mean yo, which is why the pronoun is optional.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Nosotros ___ para el examen esta noche.'
questions.explanation: The nosotros ending for an -ar verb is -amos: estudi- + -amos = estudiamos. It always has the a — not -emos or -imos.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Mi hermana ___ en una tienda los sábados.'
questions.explanation: Mi hermana is one other person (ella), so the ending is -a: trabaja. trabajan would need two or more people.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Mis amigos ___ deportes después de clase.'
questions.explanation: Mis amigos is more than one person (ellos), so the ending is -an: miran. Compare 'Mi amigo mira' (one) with 'Mis amigos miran' (more than one).

questions.q: You are asking ONE classmate a question. Choose the correct form: '¿___ el autobús para venir a la escuela?'
questions.explanation: To ask one person directly, use the tú form: usas. ¿Usa...? would be asking about someone else.
La profesora is one person (ella): enseñ- + -a = enseña. -an is for more than one, -as is only tú, and -o is only yo.
